Package io.github.lightdataframe

Class Grouper

java.lang.Object
io.github.lightdataframe.lightweightdataframe.Grouper
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable
public class Grouper extends Object implements Serializable, Cloneable
Provides functionality to group rows of a Dataframe based on custom grouping strategies. Rows are mapped to groups using a RowGrouper strategy and can belong to multiple groups.

For example, grouping the given rows:
row0: [group0, group1]
row1: [group1, group2]
row2: [group2]

results into the following groups:
group0: [row0]
group1: [row0, row1]
group2: [row1, row2]

      Sets the RowGrouper strategy for this Grouper.

    • split

      public Grouper split(int splits)
      Splits the dataframe into the specified number of groups.
      Parameters:
      splits - the number of groups to split the dataframe rows into. Must be greater than 0.
      Returns:
      the current Grouper instance with the updated row grouping strategy.

    • groupByColumnValues

      public Grouper groupByColumnValues(String... columns)
      Groups the rows of a dataframe based on the specified columns. Each row will be grouped according to its values in the specified columns.
      Parameters:
      columns - the column names to group the dataframe rows by
      Returns:
      the current Grouper instance with the updated row grouping strategy
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if one or more specified column names are not present in the dataframe

    • slidingWindow

      public Grouper slidingWindow(int step, int window)
      Groups the rows based on a sliding window strategy. The rows are grouped into windows of the specified size, with each window starting at intervals defined by the step size.
      Parameters:
      step - the interval at which each sliding window starts.
      window - the size of the sliding window. Must be a positive integer.
      Returns:
      the current Grouper instance with the updated row grouping strategy
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if either the step or window is less than or equal to 0.

    • group

      public Map<Object,Dataframe> group(Dataframe df)
      Groups the rows of the given dataframe into subsets based on a defined grouping strategy. The rows are processed according to the specified RowGrouper strategy and grouped into a map, where each key represents a group and the corresponding value is a new dataframe containing rows belonging to that group.
      Parameters:
      df - the dataframe to be grouped
      Returns:
      a map where each key is a group identifier and the corresponding value is a dataframe containing the rows belonging to that group
